messages:
Lina (Sales): GenevaHealth ready to move from POC -> pilot. Procurement returned an MSA w/ DPA redlines and a few asks: net60, PO printed on page 1, and theyre pushing for vendor-managed KMS for hosted. Any blockers?
Derek (Legal): Upload the redline pls. Immediate flags: vendor-managed KMS for hosted is non-standard; subprocessor notice is 7 days which we should push to 30; indemnity language is broad.
Lina (Sales): Uploaded: https://redwood.app/drive/GENEVA-MSA-redline.pdf. They want net60 from activation and PO on the DocuSign first page header.
Samir (Finance): Net60 from activation is risky. For pilots we usually accept net30 or net45 from signed date. If they insist on net60 we need CFO sign-off and/or payment milestones (e.g., 40% on signing). Also require PO before activation where possible.
Ivy (Eng): For the pilot we can host in eu-west-1. Vendor-managed KMS on hosted would require dedicated tenancy/HSM and changes to our ops runbook; that likely pushes to Dedicated pricing.
Derek (Legal): Proposed path: (1) decline vendor-managed KMS for hosted; offer CMK (customer-managed key) option but scoped to Dedicated/Private, (2) change subprocessor notice to 30 days with emergency 72-hour disclosure, (3) tighten indemnity and add SOC2/pen-test attestation clause. I'll draft a redline.
Lina (Sales): DocuSign routing request from buyer: procurement -> legal -> finance -> exec. They want a required checkbox "PO attached" that must be checked to finish signing. Can SignBot do that?
SignBot: Envelope draft `GENEVA-OF-2198765432` created in sandbox. Template includes a required "PO attached" checkbox and a PO header field that prints on page 1 when populated. Sandbox URL: https://docusign.redwood/ENVELOPE/2198765432.
Samir (Finance): If PO not received within 7 business days of signing we hold activation. If they insist net60 from activation, require milestone: 50% on signing, balance net60. Also confirm billing contact and invoice format (PO on header).
Ivy (Eng): I'll prepare a short data residency appendix specifying eu-west-1 processing, log categories, and retention. Will attach to order form.
Derek (Legal): Uploaded our redline draft: https://redwood.app/drive/GENEVA-MSA-our-redline.pdf. Summary: vendor-managed KMS only for Dedicated; hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS with SOC2 controls; subprocessor notice 30 days; added SLA uptime and remedies; left comments for negotiation.
Lina (Sales): Sending redline + envelope link to Geneva procurement now. Quick Q: can DocuSign auto-fill PO header if buyer supplies PO during signing?
SignBot: Yes  custom field supports auto-fill. Checkbox will block completion until PO attached or field filled.
Samir (Finance): Confirm net60 baseline: prefer signed-date start. If customer pushes activation-based net60, escalate to CFO.
Derek (Legal): If customer keeps pushing vendor-managed KMS for hosted, propose compensating controls (dedicated tenancy, audit escrow, quarterly attestations) and scope additional pricing for that configuration.
Lina (Sales): Action items: Derek finalize redline (COB), SignBot set envelope to block without PO, Samir confirm CFO threshold for net60, Ivy attach residency appendix. I'll collect PO contact and ETA from procurement. :+1:
SignBot: Envelope will move to "for signature" after legal uploads final redline. Prod envelope id reserved: `env-2198765432-prod`.
Lina (Sales): Will update here when PO/exec signature happens.
